verdict.rationale: Pulley is a SaaS equity-management platform, so offering a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows no OpenAPI or equivalent spec: every candidate OpenAPI path probed returned 404, and none of the docs mention a public API. The llms.txt file and Excel cap-table downloads are adjacent features, not an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
